description: A scrubbed steel table in the middle of a small tiled room, and everything else against the walls where it can be reached without letting go. A gas bottle on a trolley, a drip stand, an instrument tray, and a cabinet of drugs with a real lock on it and a register beside it that is filled in every single time. There is a folded blanket on the shelf under the table. It is the softest object in the building and it is not for the animals that are going home.
name: Paws for Thought — The Surgery
